name: StandardBounties
title: The Lingering Bounty of Byzantium
tagline: Born in December, this ghost waits for a final call in the Byzantium era.

chapters.heading: The birth of StandardBounties
paragraphs: A single light flickers over the name StandardBounties. It came into the world on December 18, 2017. On the day it was born it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. A wallet ending in 7645 brought it into the light.
The contract is a small program that lives on Ethereum. It arrived during the Byzantium era. It was written using Solidity 0.4.18. Now it sits nearly 9 years old in the quiet dark.

chapters.heading: The steady pulse of work
paragraphs: The contract moved with a steady rhythm. People called fulfillBounty and killBounty to move things forward. It saw 19461 transactions during its life.
It has remained active every year since 2022. It lives on bounties.network and gitcoin.co. These sites have been online since 2017 and stay online in 2026.

chapters.heading: The knocking
paragraphs: The contract sits in the quiet dark. It holds about 83 ETH. People still come to its door. They turn in work for a bounty or they end a bounty.

The code remains on the chain. It has 27 calls in the last 12 months. Its last call was on October 29, 2026. It bears two old scars: a balance check that demands an exact amount and a door left open for a caller to step back in mid-call. Never wait for an exact balance and pay last to lock the door.
